message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: Tests against recent Docker engine releases

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: 'Docker version'
        required: false
        default: 'latest'
        type: string
  schedule:
    # nightly build, at 23:59 CEST
    - cron:  '59 23 * * *'

env:
  DEVELOCITY_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEVELOCITY_ACCESS_KEY }}

jobs:
  test_docker:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        include:
          - { install-docker-type: "STABLE", version: "${{ inputs.version }}", channel: stable, rootless: false }
          - { install-docker-type: "ROOTLESS", version: "${{ inputs.version }}", channel: stable, rootless: true }
          - { install-docker-type: "ROOTFUL", version: edge, channel: test, rootless: false }
    name: "Core tests using Docker ${{ matrix.install-docker-type }} (channel ${{ matrix.channel }})"
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-build

      - name: Install Stable Docker
        id: setup_docker
        uses: docker/setup-docker-action@v5
        with:
          version: ${{ matrix.version }}
          channel: ${{ matrix.channel }}
          rootless: ${{ matrix.rootless }}

      - name: Check Docker version
        run: docker version

      - name: Cache Gradle dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.gradle/caches
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('**/*.gradle*', '**/gradle-wrapper.properties') }}

      - name: Build with Gradle
        run: ./gradlew cleanTest --no-daemon --continue --scan -Dscan.tag.DOCKER_${{ matrix.install-docker-type }} testcontainers:test -Dorg.gradle.caching=false
        env:
          DOCKER_HOST: ${{steps.setup_docker.outputs.sock}}
      - uses: ./.github/actions/setup-junit-report

      - name: Notify to Slack on failures
        if: failure()
        id: slack
        uses: slackapi/slack-github-action@v4.0.0
        with:
          payload: |
            {
              "tc_project": "testcontainers-java",
              "tc_docker_install_type": "${{ matrix.install-docker-type }}",
              "tc_github_action_url": "${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}/attempts/${{ github.run_attempt }}",
              "tc_github_action_status": "FAILED",
              "tc_slack_channel_id": "${{ secrets.SLACK_DOCKER_LATEST_CHANNEL_ID }}"
            }
        env:
          SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL: ${{ secrets.SLACK_DOCKER_LATEST_WEBHOOK }}",
  "rationale": "The workflow is Gradle-based and re-fetches dependencies on every run. Evidence pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE (measured CI workflow on fork) shows caching Gradle dependencies reduces CI elapsed time, and the literature pattern reports modest aggregate benefit with preconditions met (repeated dependency fetching; cache keyed on Gradle files). Adding actions/cache@v4 for ~/.gradle/caches before the Gradle build step preserves all existing build/test steps, required checks, secrets, and notifications, adds no privileged actions or new network access, and is a minimal change.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--91c08fe132959200"]
}
